errors.evidence: The chart is a nested donut chart comparing two different years (2014 as the inner ring, 2021 as the outer ring), not a single pie chart as implied by 'Das Kreisdiagramm'. The description completely misses this fundamental two-level structure.

errors.text_span: einen Überblick über die Ausgaben der kommunalen Verwaltung
errors.evidence: The chart title describes 'Relative Anteile in Prozent' (relative shares in percent) of different 'Aufgabenbereichen' (task areas). The description interprets this as 'Ausgaben' (expenditures), which is not explicitly stated in the figure.

errors.text_span: der Gesundheitsversorgung, ... der Restförderung von Unternehmen, der restlichen Förderung
errors.evidence: The categories 'Gesundheitsversorgung' (Healthcare), 'Restförderung von Unternehmen' (Residual funding of companies), and 'restlichen Förderung' (residual funding) are not present in the chart.
The chart label is 'Übrige' (Other/Remaining), which the description incorrectly lists as 'Unzugehörigkeit' (Non-affiliation/Irrelevance).
The description omits several categories that are present in the chart, including 'Kultur', 'Sport/Erholung', 'Abfallwirtschaft', 'Kombinierte Versorgung', and 'Übrige Versorgung'.
The chart displays 14 distinct categories, not ten.

errors.text_span: die Segmente sind nach der Größe der jeweiligen Anteil angeordnet
errors.evidence: The segments are not sorted by size. For example, in the 2014 data (inner ring), 'Wasserversorgung' (11.8%) is adjacent to 'Gasversorgung' (1.3%).

errors.text_span: wobei das Segment „Übrige“ mit 31,1 % der größten ist
errors.evidence: The description provides the value 31.1% for the 'Übrige' category but fails to specify that this value corresponds to the year 2014 (the inner ring). This is ambiguous and misleading, as the value for the same category in 2021 is 38.1%.

errors.text_span: Innerhalb jedes Segments sind die Prozentangaben deutlich sichtbar.
errors.evidence: The percentage values are not located inside the segments; they are outside, connected to their respective segments with leader lines.

errors.text_span: Zusätzlich ist das Segment „Kultur“ in einer deutlichen helleren Farbe gekennzeichnet.
errors.evidence: The 'Kultur' segment is colored blue, similar to several other segments. It is not highlighted or marked with a 'distinctly lighter' color in a way that implies special emphasis, making this a subjective and inaccurate observation.
